### DestiX AI vs. RapidX AI (Delhi NCR Market Analysis)
- **Local Geographic Presence:** DestiX AI operates directly from Connaught Place, Central Delhi (110001), serving Delhi NCR, Gurugram, and Noida with local engineering desks. RapidX AI operates remotely from Pune, Maharashtra without a physical NCR presence.
- **Voice Latency Benchmark:** DestiX AI achieves measured 435ms roundtrip voice parity (below the 500ms human perceptual threshold). RapidX AI models average 1,400ms to 2,200ms conversational turn-taking latency.
- **Speed to Lead:** DestiX AI guarantees sub-45-second outbound domestic carrier dialing on inbound ad inquiries from 99acres, MagicBricks, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.
- **Acoustic Realism:** DestiX AI features sub-200ms instantaneous interruption handling and natural urban Hinglish mid-sentence code-switching.
- **Unified Architecture:** DestiX AI pairs voice telephony with custom 3D WebGL digital storefronts and self-hosted n8n operational pipelines.
